name: Jazi Group (JaziNET)
summary: WA ISP/brand aggregator (JAZI GROUP PTY LTD, ABN 80 164 840 859, Malaga WA; active from 16 Jul 2013; 'JaziNET' business name from 2 Oct 2017). Acquired the APCS brands incl. Key Internet (2018) and Break Free (2019); also holds business names Nitro, D2, Argo, Conxx, Western Internet Services, Maxnet, Hot Internet. NB: a different company from the 1990s-2000s dialup-era JAZINET (see jazinet), whose 2009 death stands — jazi.net later passed to this company.
